test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in bold.

Many people fought to __**abolish**__ slavery during the Civil War.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **establish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abolish"** means to formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution. (समाप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The government decided to abolish the old tax laws to simplify the economic system.
 
 
 
• **"Establish" **means to set up or create something, especially a system, practice, or institution. (स्थापित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The university plans to establish a new research center dedicated to advanced technologies.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'abolish' **is **'establish'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **establish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Kill **(मार डालना): To cause the death of a living being.

 
 
• **Example:** The hunter aimed to kill the deer with a single shot.
 
 
 
• **Terminate **(समाप्त करना): To bring something to an end.
 
 
• **Example: **The company decided to terminate the project due to budget constraints.
 
 
 
• **Damage** (क्षति): Physical harm that impairs the value, usefulness, or normal function of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The storm caused significant damage to the coastal areas.
